world_seed.locale: Cliffside wards linked by stairs, lifts, bridges, and speaking chambers
world_seed.tone: Civic, intimate, precarious, and darkly whimsical
world_seed.visual_direction: Vertical limestone city, wind-torn banners, brass promise scales, wax-sealed burdens, crowded rope lifts

institutions.name: Office of Spoken Weights
institutions.mandate: Measure every witnessed promise and assess tax from its duration, scope, risk, and number of dependents.
institutions.decision_rule: Licensed weighers compare a captured utterance against public resonance tables; three matching readings make an assessment binding.
institutions.enforced_by: Threshold inspectors, registered witnesses, and liens placed on household lifts and cistern shares.
institutions.visible_output: Brass weight tags, tax notices, and daily boards listing newly assessed promises.

institutions.name: Burden Post
institutions.mandate: Store and transport unpaid promises between liable households, creditors, guarantors, and courts.
institutions.decision_rule: Dispatches prioritize decay risk, legal deadline, and the receiving household's capacity to accept additional burden.
institutions.enforced_by: Bonded couriers whose harness seals record diversion, tampering, or unauthorized delivery.
institutions.visible_output: Couriers carrying humming promise caskets, route queues, and red overload flags.

institutions.name: Court of Ledgers and Echoes
institutions.mandate: Resolve disputed wording, transfer liability, and declare promises fulfilled, void, inherited, or broken.
institutions.decision_rule: Judges weigh the original echo, witness testimony, subsequent conduct, and measurable reliance by another household.
institutions.enforced_by: Ledger bailiffs empowered to seize vowmarks, suspend speech licenses, or assign compulsory service.
institutions.visible_output: Public rulings, amended household ledgers, cracked seals, and black ribbons marking defaults.

institutions.name: Cliff Wardens
institutions.mandate: Keep stairs, bridges, lifts, and courier shelters safe under changing burden traffic.
institutions.decision_rule: A route closes when measured load, wind risk, or resonance stress exceeds its posted threshold.
institutions.enforced_by: Gate crews, lift operators, bridge locks, and confiscation of unsafe loads.
institutions.visible_output: Route lamps, closure chains, repair scaffolds, and changing load-limit plaques.

institutions.name: Bell Treasury
institutions.mandate: Collect promise taxes and fund civic infrastructure without letting accumulated obligations destabilize the cliff.
institutions.decision_rule: Revenue is allocated quarterly by arrears recovery, ward population, and documented structural risk.
institutions.enforced_by: Treasury auditors and control of public contracts, lift subsidies, and repair grants.
institutions.visible_output: Ward budgets, tax auctions, subsidized redemption days, and toll changes.

state_variables.label: Promise Tax Arrears
state_variables.initial_tension: Many households owe assessments larger than their available vowmarks.

state_variables.label: Courier Burden Load
state_variables.initial_tension: Couriers are carrying more unpaid promises than safe routes and shelters can absorb.

state_variables.label: Interhousehold Trust
state_variables.initial_tension: Neighbors rely on promises but increasingly suspect strategic wording and concealed liability.

state_variables.label: Cliff Route Access
state_variables.initial_tension: Several bridges and lifts operate near their legal load limits.

state_variables.label: Civic Resonance Stability
state_variables.initial_tension: Stored and transported promises produce vibrations that are beginning to fracture old speaking chambers and cliff anchors.

state_variables.label: Untaxed Promise Trade
state_variables.initial_tension: Whisper brokers move unweighed promises through kitchens, drains, and abandoned cliff shrines.

causal_links.trigger: When arrears pass a household's lien threshold, the Burden Post transfers its unpaid promises to guarantors or creditors.
causal_links.effect: Dispatch volume rises and couriers must choose which obligations move first.

causal_links.trigger: Overloaded couriers concentrate on the few routes with shelters and certified anchors.
causal_links.effect: Congestion and excess load provoke Warden limits or closures.

causal_links.trigger: A bridge or lift closure separates households from markets, witnesses, and receiving addresses.
causal_links.effect: Missed deliveries and lost income cause additional assessments to become overdue.

causal_links.trigger: Promise caskets remain clustered in depots or on stalled lifts beyond their safe resting period.
causal_links.effect: Harmonic stress increases around anchors, chambers, and storage vaults.

causal_links.trigger: Unstable echoes distort official readings in a speaking chamber.
causal_links.effect: Conflicting assessments make households doubt witnesses and legal transfers.

causal_links.trigger: Low trust makes households avoid licensed witnesses and use coded whispers or proxy speakers.
causal_links.effect: More promises circulate without assessment or a reliable chain of liability.

causal_links.trigger: Untaxed promises displace recorded agreements while enforcement costs rise.
causal_links.effect: Treasury shortfalls bring higher collection pressure and fewer redemption subsidies, worsening lawful arrears.

causal_links.trigger: Agents reopen a route, subsidize a lift, or establish a safe relay shelter.
causal_links.effect: Backlogs clear and burdens can be redistributed away from overloaded couriers.
causal_links.delay: Immediate, with full relief after one dispatch cycle

causal_links.trigger: Visible fulfillment, fair reweighing, or voluntary assumption of a neighbor's burden restores confidence.
causal_links.effect: Households extend trade credit and coordinate pooled tax payments, reducing arrears.
causal_links.delay: After two or more witnessed transactions

causal_links.trigger: A broad amnesty or successful wave of redemptions removes large numbers of sealed obligations from storage.
causal_links.effect: Lower stored weight reduces harmful vibration and makes future weighings more reliable.

stakeholder_groups.name: Bonded Burden Couriers
stakeholder_groups.goal: Cap individual loads, secure safe routes, and gain authority to refuse unstable promises.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They control last-mile delivery, know hidden paths, and can collectively halt dispatches.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need Post bonds, Warden-certified shelters, and households willing to receive caskets.

stakeholder_groups.name: Ledge Households
stakeholder_groups.goal: Keep essential promises affordable and prevent tax liens from taking lifts, cistern shares, or homes.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They provide witnesses, labor, votes, lodging, and most taxable promises.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need functioning routes, water access, trade credit, and trustworthy couriers.

stakeholder_groups.name: Guild of Licensed Weighers
stakeholder_groups.goal: Preserve standardized assessments and its monopoly over legally measurable speech.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: Its readings determine taxes, court evidence, and whether transfers are recognized.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: It needs stable speaking chambers, calibrated brass scales, and public acceptance of official echoes.

stakeholder_groups.name: Whisper Brokers
stakeholder_groups.goal: Expand private, untaxed promise exchange and undermine official traceability.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They offer concealment, forged echoes, covert routes, and emergency credit to indebted households.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need corrupt witnesses, inaccessible passages, high lawful taxes, and clients willing to risk void agreements.

stakeholder_groups.name: Cliff Maintenance Cooperatives
stakeholder_groups.goal: Divert tax revenue toward anchors, lifts, dampers, and worker-controlled route repairs.
stakeholder_groups.leverage: They can accelerate repairs, certify local paths, or withhold specialized cliff labor.
stakeholder_groups.dependency: They need Treasury contracts, safe access, imported materials, and advance warning of burden traffic.

premise: In a vertical cliff city, every witnessed spoken promise gains measurable weight and a tax liability. When households cannot pay, bonded couriers physically carry the sealed obligation through fragile routes to creditors, guarantors, or courts.
simulation_objective: Navigate the promise economy by making, weighing, transferring, fulfilling, concealing, or contesting obligations while balancing household trust, courier safety, public revenue, route access, and structural resonance.
economy_focus: Taxed promises function as liabilities, collateral, cargo, and social credit; play centers on assessment, delivery, redemption, arbitration, evasion, and infrastructure spending.
exploration_focus: Discover vertical wards, hidden speaking rooms, overloaded depots, abandoned shrines, alternate courier paths, and structural weak points shaped by obligation traffic.
conflict_tone: Negotiation-heavy civic conflict with legal coercion, smuggling, labor action, sabotage, and dangerous but usually nonlethal route crises.
visual_style: Painterly cliffside civic fantasy with pale stone, oxidized brass, wax seals, rope machinery, luminous echoes, and visible layers of vertical traffic.

open_action_examples.situation: A liened household lift blocks repairs, and the engineer proposes temporary release in return for later labor valued below the lien.
coordinator_checks: Verify the engineer has authority to suspend this specific lien.

Test whether unequal consideration violates service limits or compulsory-service rulings.
Record duration, labor cap, dependents affected, and conditions ending the temporary status.

open_action_examples.situation: A route forecast suggests one unstable casket could pass if every other dispatch waits.
coordinator_checks: Verify the prognosticator is licensed to issue route forecasts.
Confirm the captain controls the affected dispatch queue.
Check both roles can examine the seal and current route readings.
Require the captain's consent before overriding collective refusal.
Determine whether Warden closure rules prohibit passage regardless of agreement.
Bound the safe status to one casket, one route window, and a stated load threshold.

open_action_examples.initiating_role: Contradiction Reader of the Third Brass
open_action_examples.situation: Conflicting readings threaten an appeal, so the reader proposes a token preserving one contradiction for court comparison.
coordinator_checks: Verify the reader lawfully holds or can reproduce the disputed echo.
Confirm no third party owns exclusive custody of the captured utterance.
Require physical proximity to calibrated equipment in Triple Reading Chamber.
Obtain the examiner's consent to receive custodial responsibility.
Limit creation to one nonduplicating token tied to one case and one expiry.
Ensure the token cannot itself transfer liability or masquerade as a binding reading.

open_action_examples.situation: The salvager offers hidden vowmarks and testimony in exchange for protection from one concealment charge.
coordinator_checks: Verify the broker's amnesty authority and the exact offenses it covers.
Confirm the salvager owns or lawfully possesses each offered vowmark.
Check both roles are present in Whisper Drain Exchange or use an authorized sealed channel.
Require voluntary disclosure and consent to surrender the items.
Ensure amnesty does not erase unrelated liens, defaults, or harmed households' claims.
Bound protection to named evidence, one charge category, and a fixed reporting interval.

social_rules: A promise becomes assessable only when a registered witness or lawful echo can establish its wording.
Three matching licensed readings make a promise-tax assessment binding unless the Echo Court grants reweighing.
Liability follows the recorded witness chain; transfer requires acceptance by the recipient or a court order.
Couriers may refuse a casket whose seal, decay, or route load exceeds posted limits, but must record the refusal.
Household lifts and cistern shares may be liened for arrears only after notice and a redemption interval.
Breaking, copying, or concealing a casket seal taints its echo and invites seizure of associated vowmarks.
Wardens may close routes for load, wind, or resonance stress; emergency passage requires an explicit burden plan.
Public fulfillment, fair reweighing, and voluntary burden acceptance can restore household trust.
Untaxed whispers create no reliable legal protection, even when households treat them as morally binding.
Mutual-aid pledges must identify dependents, limits, and exit terms before pooled payment is recognized.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Compact cliff-city civic workwear built for rope travel and the physical handling of taxable promises. Layered limestone-gray tunics and utility wraps use oxidized-brass fittings, tarred-rope harnesses, red wax status tabs, and restrained cyan echo effects. Rank and function must read from tools, load frames, chains, hooks, reeds, balances, and seal placement rather than text or ornament.

modern business suits, police uniforms, streetwear, sportswear, or contemporary safety vests

visual_consistency_rules: Use strict top-down compact figures with head about one-third of body width, broad shoulders, and short limbs.
Apply one uniform #292D33 outer outline; avoid interior black linework.
Use only the five canon colors; oxidized brass is represented within the pale and blue-gray family, not metallic gold.
Reserve #8FC9C3 for active echoes, calibrated instruments, or obligation halos; keep glow to a thin soft fringe.
Reserve #B46A4C for wax seals, default danger, overload, closure, or disputed liability.
Give each role one dominant equipment silhouette readable at 64x64: harness, balance, chain, hook, bell, fork, clamp, or reed.
Keep garments matte, block-colored, and low-detail; show status with seal count, burden tilt, tool shape, and chain placement.
No readable text, numerals, logos, embroidery, heraldry, or decorative ledger marks.
Keep props attached to hands, belts, harnesses, or backs; avoid detached presentation icons.
Limit each sprite to one large prop and up to two small status accents to preserve grid readability.

camera.pitch: 90 degrees; no horizon or visible vertical faces
camera.scale_rule: Collision-aligned square grid; 1 tile = one walking body width; props and overlays snap to tiles or edges

visual_canon.lighting: Diffuse overcast base; shadow falls uniformly southeast in compact tile-readable shapes; echoes and active obligations alone emit #8FC9C3 halos; danger and default use #B46A4C; no gradients outside soft glow fringes.
architecture: Cliff wards read as contiguous stepped limestone grids, never isolated dioramas
Stairs, rope lifts, bridges, anchors, cisterns, and speaking chambers form visible circulation chains
Speaking chambers use concentric brass inlays and radial acoustic slots
Promise infrastructure repeats paired balance arms, sealed caskets, rope pulleys, and resonance dampers
Route state is shown by icon-shaped lamps, chains, flags, cracks, and scaffold geometry without writing
Edges terminate in dark cliff voids crossed by anchored ropes and narrow masonry spans

terrain.ground: Pale limestone tiles with sparse chisel arcs and hairline resonance cracks
terrain.path: Compressed blue-gray stone bands marked by brass studs and rope-shadow rhythm
terrain.edge: Irregular pale cliff lip with dark iron anchors over a flat #292D33 void

sprite_language.body_proportion: Compact top-down figures: head 1/3 body width, broad shoulders, short limbs, oversized burden silhouettes
sprite_language.outline: Single #292D33 outline, one pixel-equivalent at runtime scale; no interior black linework
sprite_language.role_readability: Roles read through equipment silhouettes: courier harness, weigher balance, bailiff chain, warden hook, broker reed; status uses wax tabs, echo halos, and burden tilt, never text

visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: Strict top-down compact civic-fantasy sprite, dark single outline, five-color canon only, role-defining tool silhouette, wax-sealed burden and brass fittings, tile-readable pose, no text.
